profile.ja: 次元侵略者・ブレインフレーヤーによって支配された終末世界の蛇子。元対魔忍たちで結成された組織“Bandit”の実戦部隊隊長である。獣遁の術“Devilfish”と彼女の中に眠る蛇神の力が覚醒し、魔神蛇子が爆誕した。蛇神と名乗らないのには深い理由と心の傷があるので取り扱い注意。覚醒の影響で、自称150センチ、実際は149センチだった身長も170センチまで伸びたが、寒くなると元の蛇子の姿に戻ってしまう。
profile.en: She is Hebiko, a captain of the combat unit of "Bandit", an organization formed by former Taimanin in a world dominated by the dimensional invader Brain Flayer. The awakening of the beast ninja art "Devilfish" and the power of the snake god within her has given rise to Magic God Hebiko. There is a deep reason and emotional scar behind her not calling herself a snake god, so handle with care. Due to the effects of her awakening, her height, which she claims to be 150 cm and actually was 149 cm, has grown to 170 cm, but she reverts to her original form when it gets cold.
